newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada transfers air traffic system to Nav Canada.
newsitem.headline: Canada transfers air traffic system to Nav Canada.

text.p: Canadian Transport Minister David Anderson on Thursday officially transferred the country's air traffic control system to Nav Canada, a private not-for-profit corporation.

"The transfer of the air navigation system to Nav Canada comes after many months of intense negotiations between Transport Canada and the not-for-profit, private corporation," Anderson said at an official signing ceremony for the transfer.
Nav Canada paid the federal government C$1.5 billion for the transfer, an amount which the two sides said "will help reduce the federal deficit."
